shadows.name: spotlight-card
shadows.purpose: The largest shadow in the system — only on the Project Spotlight container.

shadows.name: modal-backdrop

shadows.name: active-pill

shadows.name: active-tab
shadows.purpose: Selected code-file tab in the Code Inspector.

shadows.name: neo-sm-disabled
shadows.purpose: Tailwind's blanket [class*=shadow-] override maps every shadow-* utility to neo-sm in light mode; this is the canonical default that survives after Tailwind shadows are rewritten.

motion.name: panel-lift
motion.purpose: Default panel/card hover transition. Border and bg shift together.

motion.name: primary-cta-shift
motion.purpose: Signal Blue → Metric Cyan shift on every primary CTA. Same curve as panel-lift.

motion.name: pill-active
motion.purpose: Button press feedback — universal across the system.

motion.name: ambient-float-1
motion.purpose: Defined in CSS but hidden in dark mode. Drift of the first set of background gradient orbs (legacy).

motion.name: ambient-float-2
motion.purpose: Defined in CSS but hidden in dark mode. Counter-drift of the second orb set (legacy).

motion.name: fan-carousel-arc
motion.purpose: Parabolic arc fanning + 3D rotation of the fan carousel cards.

motion.name: fan-press
motion.purpose: Outer cards fading to opacity 0 + scale 0.65.

motion.name: pulse-soft
motion.purpose: Pulsing dots on the Available-for-hire status and the dashboard top-bar live indicator.

components.name: Primary CTA (Signal Blue → Cyan Shift)
components.description: Primary action button. Signal Blue at rest, Metric Cyan on hover, white label. The signature cyan-shift transition is the system's most distinctive motion.
components.css: .ds-cta-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.5rem; background:#3b82f6; color:#fff; font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:0.875rem; padding:0.625rem 1.25rem; border:none; border-radius:0.75rem; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 0.2s ease-out, transform 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-cta-primary:hover { background:#06b6d4; } .ds-cta-primary:active { transform:scale(0.95); } .ds-cta-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(34,211,238,0.6); }

components.name: Secondary CTA (Zinc Panel)
components.description: Secondary action button. Translucent zinc-950/60 fill, hairline zinc-800 border, muted text. Border brightens to zinc-700 on hover.
components.css: .ds-cta-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.5rem; background:rgba(9,9,11,0.6); color:#d4d4d8; border:1px solid rgba(39,39,42,0.8); font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:0.875rem; padding:0.625rem 1.25rem; border-radius:0.75rem; cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-cta-secondary:hover { background:rgba(24,24,27,0.4); border-color:rgba(63,63,70,0.9); color:#fff; } .ds-cta-secondary:active { transform:scale(0.95); } .ds-cta-secondary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(34,211,238,0.6); }

components.name: Project Panel Card (BentoGrid)
components.description: Universal project card surface. bg-zinc-950/60 + border-zinc-800 hairline + rounded-2xl. Hover lifts (-translate-y-0.5) and brightens (bg-zinc-900/40 + border-zinc-700).
components.css: .ds-card-project { position:relative; background:rgba(9,9,11,0.6); border:1px solid rgba(39,39,42,0.8); border-radius:1rem; padding:1.25rem; transition:all 0.2s ease-out; cursor:pointer; } .ds-card-project:hover { background:rgba(24,24,27,0.4); border-color:rgba(63,63,70,0.9); transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-badges { display:flex; gap:0.5rem; margin-bottom:0.75rem; flex-wrap:wrap; } .ds-card-project h3 { font-size:1.25rem; font-weight:700; color:#fff; margin-bottom:0.5rem; letter-spacing:-0.01em; } .ds-card-project p { font-size:0.875rem; color:#a1a1aa; line-height:1.6; }

components.css: .ds-dashboard { background:linear-gradient(135deg, #0a0e17, #020617); border-radius:1rem; padding:1rem; color:#fff; position:relative; overflow:hidden; font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace; } .ds-dashboard::before { content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; background-image:radial-gradient(circle, #06b6d4 1px, transparent 1px); background-size:16px 16px; opacity:0.15; pointer-events:none; } .ds-dash-header { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.5rem; padding-bottom:0.5rem; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(63,63,70,0.8); } .ds-pulse-cyan { width:0.5rem; height:0.5rem; border-radius:50%; background:#06b6d4; animation:pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-mono { font-size:0.6875rem; color:#06b6d4; text-transform:uppercase; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.05em; } .ds-metrics { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 1fr); gap:0.5rem; padding:0.75rem 0; } .ds-metric { background:rgba(9,9,11,0.9); border:1px solid rgba(39,39,42,0.8); border-radius:0.75rem; padding:0.625rem; } .ds-bar { height:4px; background:rgba(6,182,212,0.3); border-radius:2px; margin-top:0.375rem; overflow:hidden; } .ds-bar-fill { height:100%; background:#06b6d4; border-radius:2px; } .ds-telemetry { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:0.5rem; background:rgba(2,6,23,0.9); border:1px solid rgba(39,39,42,0.8); border-radius:0.5rem; font-size:0.625rem; color:#06b6d4; } .ds-live { color:#10b981; font-weight:600; } @keyframes pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity:1; } 50% { opacity:0.5; } }

components.name: Status Pill (Active Dev / Maintained / Archived)
components.description: Dynamic status badge. Color and dot follow the dev-status from getDevStatus(): emerald for Active, cyan for Maintained, rose for Archived.
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.375rem; padding:0.25rem 0.625rem; border-radius:0.5rem; font-size:0.6875rem; font-weight:600; border:1px solid; font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace; } .ds-status-active { background:rgba(16,185,129,0.1); color:#10b981; border-color:rgba(16,185,129,0.3); } .ds-status-maintained { background:rgba(6,182,212,0.1); color:#06b6d4; border-color:rgba(6,182,212,0.3); } .ds-status-archived { background:rgba(244,63,94,0.1); color:#f43f5e; border-color:rgba(244,63,94,0.3); } .ds-status-dot { width:0.375rem; height:0.375rem; border-radius:50%; background:currentColor; }

components.name: Section Eyebrow + Headline
components.description: The universal section-header pattern: a monospace Signal-Blue eyebrow with a // prefix, followed by an extrabold tracking-tight white headline. Used in Projects, Skills, Contact, and the modal.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.5rem; font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace; font-size:0.6875rem; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.05em; color:#3b82f6; margin-bottom:0.5rem; } .ds-headline { font-size:1.875rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.02em; color:#fff; line-height:1.1; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Universal input. Zinc-950/60 fill, hairline zinc-800 border, focus brings a cyan-500/30 ring. Used in the Live Repos search field and the Code Inspector filename bar.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; background:rgba(9,9,11,0.6); border:1px solid rgba(39,39,42,0.8); border-radius:0.75rem; padding:0.625rem 1rem; color:#fff; font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; transition:border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; outline:none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#71717a; } .ds-input:focus { border-color:#06b6d4; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(6,182,212,0.3); }

components.name: Fan Carousel Card (3D Arc)

components.css: .ds-fan-layout { position:relative; width:100%; height:22rem; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; perspective:1500px; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-fan-layout { height:32rem; } } @media (min-width: 1024px) { .ds-fan-layout { height:36rem; } } .ds-fan-card { position:absolute; width:11rem; height:16.5rem; border-radius:1.5rem; transform-origin:center bottom; will-change:transform,opacity; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-fan-card { width:17rem; height:25rem; } }

narrative.overview:
A flat dark-mode engineering portfolio that reads as a single, calm operator console. The page lives on zinc-950; every panel, card, and pill uses the same near-black surface (bg-zinc-950/60 or /80) with a 1px hairline border-zinc-800/80 edge. Depth is conveyed by panel-stack layering, three lift tiers, and the Signal Blue → Metric Cyan shift on every primary CTA — never by drop shadows, never by blur, never by gradients. This is the engineering-tool aesthetic: terminals, dashboards, IDEs.

The hero is a 12-column responsive grid: a 7-column left column with a giant monospace-tracked headline, a 3-card stat row, and three standardized CTAs; a 5-column right column with a bordered profile photograph. Every section past the hero follows the same 12-col template, the same monospace eyebrows, and the same two-tier interaction model: quiet at rest, cyan-shifted on action.

Mono-accent discipline: Signal Blue carries interactive signals, Metric Cyan carries live data and metric visualizations, Active Emerald carries only status, Amber carries only stars. Each lives in its own semantic lane.
keyCharacteristics: Flat dark, hairline-bordered panels — bg-zinc-950/60 + border-zinc-800/80 is the only surface formula.
Three-tier lift interaction model — rest (flat) → hover (-translate-y-0.5 + border brightens) → active-press (scale-95).
Mono-accent discipline with cyan-shift on action — Signal Blue at rest, Metric Cyan on hover. The signature motion.
Monospace eyebrows and labels everywhere — every section opens with a tracked // label in Signal Blue.

Dashboard-tile cards — ProjectSpotlightCard renders a stitched browser mockup with traffic-light dots, URL bar, and an inner dark-gradient panel showing Throughput / Database / Security metrics with cyan progress bars.
Live data is a first-class visual element — fetchUserRepos populates real stars, language, last-pushed, status; honest fallback states for loading, error, stale cache.

rules.name: The Signal Blue Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue carries every interactive and 'live' signal — links, focus, the active nav link, the focus ring, the status-pill border, the small ● pulse. It appears on roughly 10% or less of a screen.

rules.name: The Cyan-Shift Rule
rules.body: Every primary CTA shifts from Signal Blue at rest to Metric Cyan on hover (hover:bg-metric-cyan). This dual-color transition is the signature life of the system.

rules.name: The Panel Formula
rules.body: Every panel uses the same surface pair: bg-zinc-950/60 + border-zinc-800/80. Variations are only hover (bg-zinc-900/40 + border-zinc-700) and lift (-translate-y-0.5). Anything else is a violation.

rules.name: The Three-Accent Lane Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue = interactive. Metric Cyan = live data and metrics. Active Emerald = status. Amber = stars. They never substitute for one another.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: One typeface (Geist) for the entire system. Hierarchy comes from size, weight, and tracking — never from switching families. Mono is reserved for technical metadata only.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Every section header opens with a monospace uppercase // label in Signal Blue (or Metric Cyan in dark mode contexts). Skipping the eyebrow is a layout violation.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only on the largest containers (Spotlight card, modal backdrop) — never on buttons, inputs, or small cards.

rules.name: The Lift-By-Translate Rule
rules.body: Hover depth is always a translate-y shift (or scale-105 on the smallest pills), paired with a border-color brightening and a background brightening. Never a box-shadow change.

dos: Do use the panel formula (bg-zinc-950/60 + border-zinc-800/80 + rounded-2xl) for every card. It is the only surface formula in the system.
Do use the three-tier lift (-translate-y-0.5 on hover + border brightens + bg brightens, active:scale-95 on press) as the universal interaction pattern.
Do use the Signal Blue → Metric Cyan hover shift on every primary CTA — bg-signal-blue hover:bg-metric-cyan.
Do use monospace eyebrows (// TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY) in Signal Blue above every section heading.
Do respect the accent lane: Signal Blue for interactive, Metric Cyan for live data, Active Emerald for status, Amber for stars.
Do fetch live GitHub data via fetchUserRepos('danielaplan') with 15-min localStorage cache. Treat Live Repos as real engineering telemetry.
Do fall back honestly when GitHub returns 403 or fails — show the error panel with the original message and a Try again button.
Do keep motion subtle and short (transition-all duration-200 is the default). The fan carousel arc and the spinning refresh icon are the only long-running animations.
Do use focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-cyan-400/60 on every interactive element.
donts: Don't reintroduce glass blur, gradients, or drop shadows on regular panels — they are actively disabled in index.css.
Don't use arbitrary Tailwind color utilities (bg-blue-500, text-emerald-600) — they are silently overridden to zinc.
Don't substitute active-emerald for status-active in interactive contexts — emerald is status-only, never interactive.
Don't let primary CTAs use a single-color hover — always hover:bg-metric-cyan (cyan shift).
Don't add the breathing dot grid canvas unless wired through App.jsx — InteractiveDotGrid.jsx exists but is not in the render tree.
Don't reintroduce the neumorphic utilities (neo-raised-*, neo-inset, neo-press) on new surfaces — defined but unused.
Don't add a font family switch — Geist for everything, ui-monospace for technical metadata.
Don't disable the prefers-reduced-motion media query — it disables ambient orbs, fan transitions, and neo-press animations for users who request it.
Don't treat Tailwind shadow classes as decoration — they are overridden to neo-sm (light mode). Use arbitrary shadow-['…'] for genuine shadow needs.
